gio: quick note - onboarding magnet-30b-v2 int4. Saw a repeat/anchor drift around 18.9k tokens on a stitched prefill run. float16 stable. anyone seen stitch-related phase drift?

maya: can you share the run flags? stitch + relative index?

gio: flags: --prefill_mode=stream --stitch=true --prefill_stride=1024 --kv_index_type=relative --quant=int4

alon: relative+stitch is suspicious. compiler uses rotary_base=10000; model metadata = 65536. mismatch -> slow phase ramp.

prateek: try forcing rotary_base_override=65536 and run no-stitch to compare. also KVCACHE_DEBUG around token 18850 will help.

gio: pasted debug snippet near failure:
```
[18848] kv: rel_idx=18832 -> abs_idx=18832
[18849] rotary_phase: 0.99876 -> 0.00034 (wrap)
[18850] out_token: "the" -> "the" -> repeat
```

maya: that wrap log aligns with base mismatch. but stitch interpolation could also mis-apply phase when merging buffers.

alon: for quant angle: int4 per-layer scales can shift attention magnitudes slightly; if phase is near wrap boundary it's enough to flip token selection. run int8 fallback to confirm.

gio: running three quick jobs: (A) rotary_base_override=65536 + stitch=true (B) stitch=false (C) quant_fallback=int8. queuing to CI.

ci-bot: nightly_pipeline/run/1799998006 - magnet-30b-v2-stitch-bisect queued. artifacts at s3://redwood-ci/runs/1799998006/

prateek: if (B) is clean and (A) still fails, look at the stitch merger. we might be interpolating phase linearly instead of using the model's phase mapping which depends on base. adding unit that replays KVCACHE_DEBUG should catch it.

gio: results: (A) reduced frequency but still occasional anchors; (B) clean to 20k; (C) clean to 20k. looks like stitch + int4 amplify the effect.

maya: ok next: add a guard in stitch code that asserts phase continuity across the join and logs delta. small test should cover edge-case where relative indices cross prefill_stride.

gio: filing ML ticket ML-3221 with samples and KVCACHE_DEBUG. thanks all. :thumbsup:
